purpose: Determine whether the sealed attempt-009 acquisition is structurally usable at the raw-data layer using a materially faster, read-only, fail-closed validation.
necessaryGates: sealed measured and execution-evidence file sets, byte counts, and SHA-256 values remain exact
launch, authorization, schema, D3, identity-binding, implementation, fairness, runtime, and acquisition bindings remain exact
process ledger has exactly 1147 trusted zero-exit rows with strict ordinals 0..1146 and frozen mode counts
all 1147 process identity receipts bind one-to-one to the ledger and prove RunnerV3, natural exit, no signal, and no retry
failure and replacement ledgers are empty
162 accepted superblocks, 162 oracle receipts, 972 lane receipts, 12 empty-boundary receipts, and instrument receipt close exactly
every raw JSONL nonblank line parses to a flat object and contains all frozen required fields
numeric values are finite and signed-int64 safe where applicable
record identifiers are unique within exact disjoint file partitions
row source paths are canonical and every distinct source file is hashed exactly once then cache-compared for every row
anonymous lane and identity-binding values remain sealed and valid during validation
lane, oracle, empty-boundary, measurement-point, D3-window, and per-receipt row cardinalities close exactly
D3-v3.1 row semantics, rate arithmetic, prohibited-field absence, and one-to-one event/empty joins pass
accepted event rows remain eligible, finite-positive, counter-valid, and budget-exceedance-free
persistent-state component uniqueness and point totals close per lane without retaining the whole dataset
operation rows retain nonnegative managed-allocation diagnostics and a nonempty native-semantics identifier

performanceRules.sealedFileHashing: one current SHA-256 calculation per sealed file, parallelized with bounded workers
performanceRules.rowSourceHashing: one path resolution, canonicality check, and SHA-256 calculation per distinct canonical source path; every later row uses only exact cached string comparisons
performanceRules.rowMemory: stream file-by-file; discard row objects immediately except bounded D3 and join indexes
performanceRules.globalUniqueness: exact per-file uniqueness plus enforced disjoint partition identity; bounded global sets only for join-bearing D3 rows
performanceRules.progress: write progress only to this verification root

predecessorAttempt.failureReason: v1 cached content hashes but still repeated filesystem path canonicalization on every row

explicitExclusions: CSV, gzip JSONL, or typed-Parquet materialization and round-trip
formal-effect analysis or use of qualification observations as formal samples
quality, effect, direction, ranking, weighting, or winner computation

verdicts.scopeWarning: A pass is not the original attempt-009 qualification terminal PASS and does not assert delivery or typed-Parquet PASS.
